patch.value: Coordinate parallel agents on a shared tracker without git
Make tracker coordination primary and Git worktree lanes optional, with real concurrent-process acceptance.
All eight commands have explicit no-git behavior; existing Git tests and unchanged release gates pass; packed no-git consumer and concurrent claims retain healthy history.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: detect workspace mode once without invoking Git on non-repository paths; settings bypasses repository detection. Reuse certified SDK readiness, deterministic selection and overlap rules. Shared lanes are claimed items, with SDK claim provenance for age and no branch/base fields. Hold a tracker-local SDK lease across selection, claim and terminal reaping. Shared status reports declared overlaps, explicitly omitting Git measurements; watch emits overlap changes without claim-age polling noise. Sync accepts explicit portable files and retains preview/apply semantics; land explains the Git requirement. Preserve existing Git behavior and ownership checks; release terminal claims only for the invoking principal, reporting foreign claims as refused.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: shared tracker uses the host-bound SDK client, certified readiness and a tracker-local 60-second bounded operation lease. Eight simultaneous CLI processes retained eight distinct claims in the first run. Source-loaded test extension metadata causes strict health extension warnings, while integrity/history checks pass; test health isolates extension discovery and packed acceptance separately verifies the managed tarball. Pinned host gap: some expected extension refusals return exit 1 with human diagnostics and exit 2 with JSON. No CLI/SDK changes or dependency bumps.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Correction after tracing refusal handling: asynchronous method rejections bypassed runCommand catch because it returned promises without awaiting them. This is a package dispatcher issue, not a proven host JSON/human gap. Await operations inside the existing expected-error boundary so refusals consistently preserve the intended exit 2 and full actionable message. Regression assertions cover strict overlap, missing explicit files and Git-only landing refusals.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Focused refusal regressions now pass 3/3 after awaiting dispatcher operations. Contention run: eight processes, eight distinct claims retained, nine JSONL histories parse cleanly, strict health (source-extension discovery disabled only for this unmanaged fixture) passes; contention elapsed 26462 ms under concurrent host load. Managed packed acceptance runs next-to-sync-to-status-to-terminal-reap under Node and native Bun with Git absent from PATH.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Packed tarball acceptance passed under both Node and native Bun: pm install ./package.tgz --project in a non-Git tracker, then next, sync --files --apply, status, terminal stale-claim reap, and full managed-extension pm health --strict-exit. Git was absent from PATH for the loop; total targeted acceptance elapsed 136738 ms. Initial coverage exposed that source-loaded CLI extension code is not fully attributed to authored TypeScript by c8; adding direct registered-handler SDK coverage with real trackers alongside process acceptance, without changing source inventory or thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs in an isolated source copy with the same pinned SDK and real trackers: restoring only runCommand to origin/main makes 9/9 no-git regressions fail (exit 1), including the matrix where all eight commands exit 2 with first line Error: Command failed and git rev-parse in the detail. Disabling only SharedTracker.sharedExclusive makes the eight-process test fail (exit 1) on an already-claimed race. Reverting only the age-independent watch comparison makes the watch regression fail (exit 1) with spurious lane_changed events. Current implementations retained; source-import tests require no dist rebuild.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional artifact revert proof: rebuilt an isolated source copy with only runCommand reverted to origin/main, packed it, installed the tarball in a real non-Git tracker, and ran the new packed acceptance. Build passed; acceptance failed at next with host exit 2 and test exit 1. This independently proves the compiled installed artifact test detects the original Git prerequisite.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Native human-output matrix passes: plan, next, start, status, sync with explicit files, reap and settings exit 0. Coordination results begin mode: shared-tracker; settings begins swarm:. The old dispatcher proof exits 2 with that generic first line for every command. docs/shared-tracker-verification.md records exact before/after lines and the artifact revert proof.
